prerequisites: successfully attended the courses of: Fundamentals of Mathematics

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic knowledge in mathematical analysis in connection with the study of functions of several variables, with the definition of simple decision models, with the solution of minimum problems of functions of several variables.

Ability to study the continuity and differentiability of a function of several variables and to solve some exercises related to the determination of minimum points of linear and/or nonlinear problems.

Ability to understand the nature of decision problems by studying the properties of a function of several variables; ability to establish the most appropriate method to solve a linear or nonlinear minimum problem.

syllabus_topics: Functions of several real variables with real values (10 hours)
Limits and continuity for functions of several variables (10 hours)
Differentiation of functions of several variables (10 hours)
Convexity of sets and functions in R^n (5 hours)
Maxima and minima of functions of several variables (10 hours)
assessment_rules: To pass the exam, a grade not lower than 18/30 is required. The student must demonstrate sufficient knowledge of the topics covered and the ability to formulate a linear programming model. To achieve a score of 30/30 cum laude, the student must demonstrate excellent knowledge of all topics, connecting them logically and coherently.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
